LanguageData.RatkinQL_MinstrelTree_Report: A wandering performer stopped by, offering songs and old tales for a few coins.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Minstrel_Greeting: Clutching a battered lute, she gives you a warm smile. “{Interviewer_labelShort}, care to toss a coin and hear a tune? I know all the old ones.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Minstrel_OptSong: Toss her a few coins and hear a song (5 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Minstrel_OptTale: Ask her to tell a Ratkin legend.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Minstrel_Tale1: “They say Mother Earth dug the first burrow with her own claws, and we’ve been crawling through her tunnels ever since.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Minstrel_Tale2: “The first rat to brew beer stole fire from a sleeping human. He got drunk, burned his whiskers, but we’ve toasted him every harvest since.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Minstrel_Tale3: “When the Great Flood came, our ancestors floated on a hollow log with a pregnant mother and a bag of seeds. That’s where all the little clans come from.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Minstrel_Farewell: She tucks her lute under her arm, gives a small bow, and heads off.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Minstrel_MsgSong: She plucks the strings and sings a merry little tune, drawing smiles from everyone nearby.
